thread:
olivia: Heads up — after last night's BMC firmware push to sa-east1 (racks gaia-3, gaia-4) about 12 nodes in cluster-gpu-3 are stuck in POST. BMC responds to IPMI but auto-start sequence never fires.

raj: Which jobs failed? Any error logs from the postflash hook?

olivia: quick snip from one node:
```
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.10.3.21 -U admin -P **** chassis power status
Chassis Power is off
# ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.10.3.21 -U admin -P **** sol info
SOL Parameter not set
``` 
And BMC syslog shows repeated `watchdog: autostart failed` and `rtc: clock not set`.

infra-bot: Firmware rollout job 2026-03-17T02:14Z completed for rack gaia-3 (12/120 nodes failed post-flash healthcheck) :warning:

jana: rtc / NTP skew can block TPM/secureboot checks on some vendors. Did the firmware change the RTC handling? :thinking:

marco: saw similar on a lab chassis — firmware reset the RTC to 1970, causing kernel to bail on TPM seeding. If secure-boot attestation is strict the platform will stop boot. Try setting the RTC then power-cycle.

olivia: trying `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.10.3.21 -U admin -P **** raw 0x06 0x01 0x00` to set time via bmc, but management plane is rate-limited — some 429s in the upgrade job logs. Might be ACL/rate limit kicking in from orchestration.

raj: we pushed a tighter ACL on the mgmt network yesterday (to reduce noisy scans). Could be blocking the scheduler's parallel remediation. Can we throttle the rollout and give workers a longer retry window?

oncall-sre: Paused the remaining firmware jobs in sa-east1. Opening incident runbook PR to add postflash healthcheck: set RTC -> verify NTP sync -> quick TPM/seal check -> boot. Also adding exponential backoff for BMC API calls to avoid 429 storms.

olivia: temporary manual workaround for current failed nodes: 1) set clock via IPMI, 2) `ipmitool chassis bootdev disk`, 3) power cycle, 4) monitor `journalctl -b` for tpm/secureboot errors. Two nodes recovered so far.

marco: filing a vendor bug — their firmware v2.8 changed RTC restore behavior. Linking firmware vendor ticket: https://vendor.example/ticket/7891

jana: follow-up: can we add a small gate in the rollout job to query `ntpstat` on BMC or check `rtc` before allowing parallel power ops? Saves us from manual rollout pauses. :+1:

raj: I'll open a rollback patch to the firmware campaign to revert the RTC behavior branch while we get vendor patch. For now leave the rollout paused and continue manual remediation.

olivia: thanks. logging the affected hostnames in the incident doc and will post update after next set of 5 nodes. :eyes:
